name: Jellyseerr Bridge
overview: Jellyseerr inside Jellyfin: button, embedded view, search and sign-in.
description: Brings Jellyseerr into the Jellyfin web client: a button in the header and side menu, Jellyseerr embedded in Jellyfin instead of a redirect, Jellyseerr suggestions under Jellyfin search results with one-click requests attributed to the right user, optional single sign-on via Quick Connect, and a compatibility bridge for clients that still send legacy X-Emby authorization headers. Settings page is in German; the button label follows each user's language.
changelog: Header and side-menu button, embedded view, search suggestions with requests, single sign-on via Quick Connect, legacy auth header bridge.
